units: B. Kam. 23ᵇ זיל … דלִיצְנְעִינְהוּ (Ar. אַצְנְעִינְהוּ Af.) go and tell the owner of the goats to guard them (from trespassing on my property).—Part. pass. צְנִיעַ; pl. צְנִיעִין
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 10:5">Targ. Y. Deut. X, 5</cite>.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 58a:10">B. Bath. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>אמאי לא צְנִיעַת באיסורא</he> why art thou not more guarded in thy immoral conduct?—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 16:23">Targ. Lev. XVI, 23</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 25b:15">B. Mets. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>אטו אמוריים מַצְנְעֵי וכ׳</he> is it only Amorites that hide (their treasures in walls) &c.? <cite ref="Bava Batra 24a:13">B. Bath. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>דמיגניב מניה ואִיצַּנּוּעֵי בגויה לא מצנעי</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note for Var. Lect.) as to being stolen from there and hidden, they would not hide it in the same grounds from the surface of which they had taken it.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 24a:13">Ib.</cite> <he>אבל עינבי מַצְנְעֵי</he> (or <he>מִיצְנְעֵי</he>) but grapes they may hide in the same grounds; a. e.—B. Kam. l. c. <he>אַצְנְעִינְהוּ</he> guard them, v. supra.—[<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:16:3">Cant. R. to I, 16</cite> <he>מצנעה</he>, v. <cite ref="N01003"><he>נְעַץ</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: to restrain, make a person respect authority.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 36b:59">Nidd. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>זיל צַנְּעֵיה</he> go and make him respect my authority.

senses.gloss: to cause a person to live in retirement (a mild method of excommunication).
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 25a:2">Kidd. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>זיל צַנְּעִינְהוּ</he> go and tell them to withdraw (cmp. <he>הכבד ושב בביתך</he>, <cite ref="Moed Katan 17a">M. Kat. 17ᵃ</cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 14:15">Targ. Y. Gen. XIV, 15</cite> (not <he>אַצְטִינְעָא</he>).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 60a:6">B. Bath. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>מצינא לאִצְטַנּוּעֵי מינך</he> I can be private (protect myself) from thy gaze.
